Objector** # ** CORRIGENDUM ** The Commission vide its order dated 16.2.2023 in Petition No. 578/GT/2020 had revised the tariff of Maithon Hydel Power Station, Units-I to III (63.2 MW) for the period 2014-19, after truing up exercise and had determined the tariff of the generating station _Corrigendum Order in Petition No. 578/GT/2020 Page_ **_1_** _of_ **_3_** for the period 2019-24.
